units.aspect: degree clockwise from grid north, downhill

metadata.coordinateAxes: x = projected easting; y = projected grid north. Rows run north to south. Distances in projected metres; no Earth CRS or geodesic conversion.
metadata.method: Zevenbergen-Thorne central 3x3 first/second derivatives; Riley 3x3 TRI; full square 11x11 and 51x51 m TPI excluding center; max-minus-min relief; geometric profile and true planform curvature following xDEM documented equations, without xDEM factor100.
metadata.methodStatus: Equations reproduced in NumPy/SciPy; analytic synthetic numerical tests. xDEM/GDAL methods cited; libraries were not installed and no library cross-validation is claimed.

support.aspect: 3x3 m; gradient magnitude >1e-9; clockwise downhill from grid north
support.profileCurvature: 3x3 m; null at flat or critical points
support.planCurvature: 3x3 m; null at flat or critical points
support.exposure: Euclidean distance <=20 m from native slope >25 degrees. Full43x43 m source support required. Geometric proximity proxy, not calibrated probability or rockfall trajectory.

metadata.aggregation: All morphology fields are native1m calculations aggregated by arithmetic mean into exact5x5 native blocks; any missing support makes the output field null. Aspect is circular mean; opposing/undefined directions null. Coverage/support are fractions; uncertainty bits use bitwise OR. Existing maximum native slope hard constraint is not replaced.
metadata.curvatureSign: Positive convex, negative concave, units1/m, NOT multiplied100. Planform denominator gradient^3 differs from tangential curvature. Direction undefined at zero gradient.
metadata.noData: JSON null / GeoTIFF NaN. No padding, interpolation, filling or extrapolation across crop edges/holes.

uncertaintyBits.16: aspect/profile/plan curvature undefined at zero gradient
uncertaintyBits.32: DEM vertical and inter-product registration accuracy not quantitatively provided

metadata.accuracy: 1m is pixel spacing, not vertical accuracy. Quantized source heights and differentiation amplify noise, especially curvature. Planform curvature is ill-conditioned near flat surfaces even where its gradient is nonzero. No sigma/probability invented. Morphology does not measure soil strength, slip or astronaut safety.

sensorCoverage.interpretation: Availability only. Optical detector support is absent; no soil strength or slip estimate.

opticalProxy.meaning: No independently evaluated local optical detector product is supplied for this region. Null is not zero rock abundance. Published NOAH-H texture classes are a separate evidence layer.

source.credit: NASA MRO HiRISE / Caltech; Annex & Ehlmann (2024)
source.processing: Existing native 1 m crop copied into little-endian Float32; no spatial resampling, terrain synthesis or vertical exaggeration
